Name: Gifts from Marnie - Cozy Farm Gifts and Animal Care
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
[center][b][size=4]It's time to get some love back! 🎁✨[/size][/b]

Let's be honest: you spend days chasing villagers around town, memorizing their bizarre schedules,
and spending a fortune on rare items just to get... silence? Or maybe a recipe you'll never actually make. 🙄[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=4]Those one-sided days are over![/size][/b][/center]
[center]
All the dedication, effort, and hard-earned cash spent building a friendship now come right back to you.
With this mod, camaraderie is a two-way street: receive unique letters and gifts at every friendship level,and the rewards get better with every single heart you earn! ❤️📈

[b][size=4]Finally, making new friends is completely worth it! 🤝💥[/size][/b]

Enjoy the basic perks early on and get ready to be surprised by advanced loot as your bond deepens.
From common stones found on the ground to precious relics and survival tools...
after all, every character has their own unique taste (and level of sanity)! 💎
[i]Clear out your mailbox, prepare your inventory space, and start enjoying the return on your investment![/i] 😉🎒
[/center]
[center][color=#ffffff][b]────────────────────────────────────[/b][/color][/center]
[center]💬 Feel free to leave comments, suggestions, or emotional support.
Don't forget to [b]⭐ Endorse ⭐[/b] the mods you like![/center]

Plus, it motivates me to keep updating and creating more content. 👍🏼
